name: Klaviyo
summary: Email, SMS and push campaign and flow performance (opens, clicks, conversions, revenue), metrics and their aggregates from a Klaviyo account.

api_key.description: a Klaviyo private API key (Settings > API keys) with read scopes for campaigns, flows and metrics

notes: Every call carries a revision header (an API version date); this entry pins 2026-10-15.

Bodies are JSON:API: {"data": {"type": ..., "attributes": {...}}}. List filters are strings such as equals(status,'live') or greater-than(created,2026-01-01T00:00:00Z); paging follows links.next or page[cursor].
Reporting endpoints (campaign and flow values) are rate limited hard: 1 per second, 2 per minute, 225 per day. They match the numbers in Klaviyo's UI; metric aggregates are for raw event counts.
Reports need a conversion_metric_id: find the Placed Order (or other conversion) metric's id with klaviyo.metrics.list.

endpoints.name: Campaign performance report
endpoints.summary: Opens, clicks, deliveries, conversions and revenue per campaign (and message, channel) over a timeframe.

data.description: {"type": "campaign-values-report", "attributes": {statistics, timeframe, conversion_metric_id, group_by, filter}}. statistics (required): any of average_order_value, bounce_rate, bounced, bounced_or_failed, bounced_or_failed_rate, click_rate, click_to_open_rate, clicks, clicks_unique, conversion_rate, conversion_uniques, conversion_value, conversions, delivered, delivery_rate, failed, failed_rate, message_segment_count_sum, open_rate, opens, opens_unique, recipients, revenue_per_recipient, spam_complaint_rate, spam_complaints, text_message_credit_usage_amount, text_message_roi, text_message_spend, unsubscribe_rate, unsubscribe_uniques, unsubscribes. timeframe (required): {"key": one of last_12_months, last_30_days, last_365_days, last_3_months, last_7_days, last_90_days, last_month, last_week, last_year, this_month, this_week, this_year, today, yesterday} or {"start", "end"} date-times, at most one year, in the account's timezone. conversion_metric_id (required): the metric id conversions count (e.g. Placed Order, from klaviyo.metrics.list). group_by: any of campaign_id, campaign_message_id, campaign_message_name, group, group_name, send_channel, tag_id, tag_name, text_message_format, variation, variation_name. filter: e.g. and(equals(campaign_id,"abc"),contains-any(send_channel,["email","sms"])); send_channel is email, sms, push-notification or whatsapp.

notes: A read over POST. Needs campaigns:read. 1/s, 2/min, 225/day.

endpoints.name: Flow performance report
endpoints.summary: Opens, clicks, deliveries, conversions and revenue per flow (and message, channel) over a timeframe.

data.description: {"type": "flow-values-report", "attributes": {statistics, timeframe, conversion_metric_id, group_by, filter}}. statistics (required): any of average_order_value, bounce_rate, bounced, bounced_or_failed, bounced_or_failed_rate, click_rate, click_to_open_rate, clicks, clicks_unique, conversion_rate, conversion_uniques, conversion_value, conversions, delivered, delivery_rate, failed, failed_rate, message_segment_count_sum, open_rate, opens, opens_unique, recipients, revenue_per_recipient, spam_complaint_rate, spam_complaints, text_message_credit_usage_amount, text_message_roi, text_message_spend, unsubscribe_rate, unsubscribe_uniques, unsubscribes. timeframe (required): {"key": one of last_12_months, last_30_days, last_365_days, last_3_months, last_7_days, last_90_days, last_month, last_week, last_year, this_month, this_week, this_year, today, yesterday} or {"start", "end"} date-times, at most one year, in the account's timezone. conversion_metric_id (required): the metric id conversions count (e.g. Placed Order, from klaviyo.metrics.list). group_by: any of flow_id, flow_message_id, flow_message_name, flow_name, send_channel, tag_id, tag_name, text_message_format, variation, variation_name. filter: e.g. and(equals(flow_id,"abc"),contains-any(send_channel,["email","sms"])); send_channel is email, sms, push-notification or whatsapp.

notes: A read over POST. Needs flows:read. 1/s, 2/min, 225/day.

endpoints.name: List campaigns
endpoints.summary: Campaigns with name, status, send settings and optionally their messages, audiences and tags.

filter.description: Filter string. Fields: id (any), name (contains), archived (equals), builder (equals), created_at / updated_at (greater-or-equal, greater-than, less-or-equal, less-than).

endpoints.name: List flows
endpoints.summary: Automated flows with name, status, trigger type and dates.

filter.description: Filter string. Fields: id (any), name (contains, ends-with, equals, starts-with), status (equals), archived (equals), created / updated (equals, greater-or-equal, greater-than, less-or-equal, less-than), trigger_type (equals: Metric, Added to List, Unconfigured, Date Based, Price Drop, Low Inventory).

sort.description: created, id, name, status, trigger_type or updated; prefix - for descending.

endpoints.name: List metrics
endpoints.summary: Event metrics in the account (Placed Order, Opened Email, ...) with their ids and integrations.

endpoints.name: Aggregate a metric over time
endpoints.summary: Counts, sums or unique counts of one metric's events per day, hour, week or month, optionally grouped by dimensions like $flow or Campaign Name.

data.description: {"type": "metric-aggregate", "attributes": {metric_id (required), measurements (required: count, sum_value, unique), filter (required: a datetime range as ["greater-or-equal(datetime,...)", "less-than(datetime,...)"]), interval (day default, hour, week, month), by (dimensions such as $flow, $message, $attributed_channel, Campaign Name, URL), timezone (IANA, default UTC), page_size (default 500), sort}}.

notes: A read over POST. Needs metrics:read. 3/s, 60/min.
Custom metrics are not supported here.
